title: Frontend Performance Optimization for PageSpeed 90+

requirements.text: Update the OptimizedImage component and all other image tags across the frontend to use WebP format with PNG/JPEG fallback via <picture> elements. Implement native lazy loading (loading="lazy") for all images below the fold. For the hero/LCP image in Hero.tsx, set fetchpriority="high" and explicitly remove any lazy loading attribute so it loads eagerly.

quotes: Convert all images to WebP format. Implement native lazy loading for all images below the fold. For the hero image (LCP element), set fetchpriority="high" and ensure it is not lazy-loaded.

acceptanceCriteria: All images below the fold have loading="lazy" attribute
Hero/LCP image has fetchpriority="high" and no lazy loading
Images are served as WebP with fallback via <picture> element
OptimizedImage component reflects these changes

requirements.text: Ensure the Vite build configuration in vite.config.ts is set to produce fully minified HTML, CSS, and JavaScript output. Verify terser minification options are enabled with aggressive settings (remove comments, collapse whitespace, mangle variable names). Confirm CSS minification is active in the build pipeline.

quotes: Minify all HTML, CSS, and JavaScript files to reduce payload size.

acceptanceCriteria: Production build output JS files are minified and mangled
CSS output files are minified with no whitespace
HTML entry point is minified in the build output
Terser options in vite.config.ts include compress and mangle settings

requirements.text: In frontend/index.html, extract critical above-the-fold CSS and inline it directly into a <style> tag in the <head>. For non-essential JavaScript (excluding the main app bundle), add defer or async attributes so they do not block the initial page render. Any script tags that are not required for first paint should use defer.

quotes: Identify non-critical CSS and inline it into the <head>. Defer or use async for all non-essential JavaScript so it doesn't block the initial page render.

acceptanceCriteria: Critical CSS for above-the-fold content is inlined in <head>
Non-essential <script> tags in index.html have defer or async attribute
No render-blocking scripts appear before the closing </body> tag without defer/async
Page renders initial content without waiting for deferred scripts

requirements.text: Audit all tags and video containers across the frontend components (Hero.tsx, ProductGrid.tsx, ProductManagement.tsx, OptimizedImage.tsx, TrustBadges.tsx, etc.) and ensure every image and video element has explicit width and height attributes set. This reserves layout space during loading and eliminates Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS).

quotes: Add explicit width and height attributes to all image tags and video containers to reserve space during loading.

acceptanceCriteria: All tags have explicit width and height attributes
All video container elements have explicit dimensions
OptimizedImage component passes through width/height props to the rendered element
No image or video element lacks dimension attributes

requirements.text: Update or verify the existing delayedScripts utility (frontend/src/utils/delayedScripts.ts) to ensure all third-party tracking scripts (including Google Analytics in index.html) and heavy widgets are deferred until 3 seconds after the window.load event fires. Move any inline Google Analytics initialization in index.html to use this delayed loading mechanism.

quotes: Delay the execution of any third-party tracking scripts or heavy widgets until 3 seconds after the 'window.load' event to prioritize the main content.

acceptanceCriteria: Google Analytics and other third-party scripts are not loaded on initial page parse
delayedScripts.ts injects tracking scripts at least 3 seconds after window.load
No third-party scripts block the critical rendering path
The 3-second delay logic is correctly applied before script injection

requirements.text: Ensure all @font-face declarations and Google Fonts imports in frontend/src/index.css and frontend/index.html include font-display: swap so that fallback text is shown immediately while web fonts are loading, preventing invisible text (FOIT).

quotes: Ensure all web fonts use font-display: swap to prevent invisible text during loading.

acceptanceCriteria: All @font-face rules in index.css include font-display: swap
Any Google Fonts URL in index.html includes &display=swap parameter
No web font loading causes invisible text during page load

constraints: Do not modify files listed in frontend.immutablePaths: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui
All changes are frontend-only; do not alter backend/main.mo
Maintain existing functionality — optimizations must not break product loading, admin panel, or affiliate link behavior
nonGoals: Cloudflare CDN configuration (documented separately in CLOUDFLARE_CDN_SETUP.md)
Service worker changes beyond what is needed for asset caching
Adding new product features or UI redesign
